import sys

def main():
    sb = []
    for line in sys.stdin:
        sb.append(line)
    token = ''.join(sb).split()[0]

    extended = "#" + token

    i = 1
    ans = 0
    while i < len(extended):
        start = i
        while i < len(extended) and extended[i] == extended[start]:
            i += 1
        length = i - start
        if length % 2 == 0:
            ans += 1

    print(ans)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
